lead.event: Rupiah hits record low against the US dollar
lead.headline: Rupiah hits record low at Rp18,239 per US dollar
lead.blurb: The currency touched Rp18,239 per US dollar on 12 November and closed at Rp18,206 on 13 November. Sucor Sekuritas' Hendry Wijaya says rupiah depreciation and foreign outflows, with year-to-date net selling of about Rp97 trillion, may pressure the IHSG. He says 64% of at-risk foreign exposure is concentrated in BCA, BRI, Mandiri and BNI, while exporters earning dollars are relatively protected. Investors face Bank Indonesia's meeting on 17–18 November, MSCI rebalancing at the 30 November close and the Fed's rate decision on 9 December.

other.event: ULTJ sets cum date for additional Rp100 per share dividend
other.headline: ULTJ sets 16 November cum date for additional Rp100-per-share dividend
other.blurb: Ultrajaya’s additional Rp1 trillion cash dividend for fiscal 2025 was approved at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 6 November. It will be funded from unrestricted retained earnings, which stood at Rp7.5 trillion at year-end 2025; the company previously paid a final dividend of Rp130 per share on 22 May.

earnings_guidance.event: Antam reports Rp9.7 trillion net profit through September 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports Rp9.7 trillion net profit through September, up 46%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aneka Tambang’s revenue rose 23% year on year to Rp88.48 trillion, while its net profit margin widened to 11% from 9%. Finance and Risk Management Director Arini Kasmira attributed growth to revenue optimization, cost efficiency and disciplined financial and risk management.

market_structure_policy.event: FTSE Russell removes 14 Indonesian stocks in December index review
market_structure_policy.headline: FTSE Russell removes 14 Indonesian stocks in December index review
market_structure_policy.blurb: Indonesia remains a Secondary Emerging Market and off FTSE Russell’s Watch List. The changes take effect on 21 December, with results provisional through 4 December and final from 7 December.

deals_control.event: COIN agrees to acquire 10% stake in data center company MIG
deals_control.headline: COIN agrees to acquire 10% of MIG for Rp200 billion
deals_control.blurb: Indokripto Koin Semesta signed a conditional share subscription agreement on 13 November to buy 1,223,435 new series B shares in MIG, each with a nominal value of Rp163,475. The subscription would give it a 10% stake in the data center and IT services provider.
